turns.transliteration: parhAI kI mez para, eka kaMpyUTara, kuCha kitAbeM aura eka kaॉfI kapa hai

turns.meaning: In this almirah, there are my clothes and shoes. Look, there are beautiful pictures on that wall. There is a mirror behind the door too

turns.transliteration: tumhAre kamare kA paradA bahuta sundara hai | aura lagatA hai ki paMkhA nayA hai
turns.meaning: The curtain of your room is very beautiful. It seems that fan is new

turns.hindi: जी हाँ, नया पंखा और नयी दरी भी
turns.transliteration: jI hA.N, nayA paMkhA aura nayI darI bhI
turns.meaning: Yes, New fan and new rug too

turns.transliteration: tumhArA kamarA bahuta barA aura havAdAra bhI hai
turns.meaning: Your room is very bog and airy too

turns.transliteration: dhanyavAda ! kyA tuma bhI mujhe apanA kamarA aura ghara dikhAogI
turns.meaning: Thanks ! Will you also show me your room and house

turns.hindi: हाँ, ज़रूर, क्यों नहीं

turns.meaning: Yes, indeed, why not

turns.meaning: I am from Patna, India. Where are you from

turns.meaning: Yes, Iowa City is very small, but very lovely town

turns.meaning: Is there any airport there

turns.meaning: No, but there is an airport in near by town. Even railway station is not there in Iowa City. There is just one bus station

turns.transliteration: AyovA siTI meM, kitane vidyAlaya, mahAvidyAlaya, aura vishvavidyAlaya haiM
turns.meaning: How many schools, colleges, and universities are there in Iowa CIty

turns.meaning: In my town, there are two schools, one college, and one university

turns.meaning: Is there any library, museum, cinema hall and zoo in your town

turns.meaning: Yes, in my town, there are two libraries, one museum, one cinema hall. But, there is no zoo

turns.hindi: अच्छा, क्या आयोवा सिटी में, कोई नदी, झील, तालाब और पहाड़ हैं
turns.transliteration: achChA, kyA AyovA siTI meM, koI nadI, jhIla, tAlAba aura pahAr haiM
turns.meaning: Okay, Is there any river, lake, pond and mountain in Iowa City

turns.meaning: In my town, there is a river and a few ponds. There is no mountain there. Iowa is an agriculture based state and there is a lot of even and farm land

turns.meaning: In your town, is there a post office, and a police station, etc

turns.meaning: Yes, In my town, there is one post office, and one police station too. What are there in Patna

turns.meaning: Let’s talk about Patna later. Now, it is time for class

turns.meaning: I think, it is quite expensive

turns.meaning: No, the price is absolutely right. Do you know that we import eggplants from other states

turns.hindi: छठ पूजा हिन्दुओं का एक बहुत ही पवित्र पर्व है | छठ पूजा में हम सूर्य भगवान की पूजा करते हैं
turns.transliteration: ChaTha pUjA hinduoM kA eka bahuta hI pavitra parva hai | ChaTha pUjA meM hama sUrya bhagavAna kI pUjA karate haiM
turns.meaning: Chhath pooja is a holy festival of Hindus. In Chhath pooja, we worship God sun

turns.hindi: क्या तुम मुझे छठ पूजा में अपने घर बुलाओगे
turns.transliteration: kyA tuma mujhe ChaTha pUjA meM apane ghara bulAoge
turns.meaning: Will you invite me to your home on Chhath pooja

turns.hindi: हाँ बिल्कुल, अगले छठ पूजा में तुम मेरे घर ज़रूर आना
turns.transliteration: hA.N bilkula, agale ChaTha pUjA meM tuma mere ghara zrUra AnA
turns.meaning: Yes, of course, you must come to my home on next Chhath pooja

turns.hindi: और मैं
turns.transliteration: aura maiM
turns.meaning: And me

turns.hindi: तुम्हारा भी स्वागत है
turns.transliteration: tumhArA bhI svAgata hai
turns.meaning: You are also welcome

turns.hindi: नमस्ते माँ, तुम कैसी हो और अभी क्या कर रही हो
turns.transliteration: namaste mA.N, tuma kaisI ho aura abhI kyA kara rahI ho
turns.meaning: Hello mother, how are you and what are you doing right now

turns.hindi: नमस्ते बेटी, मैं ठीक हूँ और अभी अपना सामान पैक कर रही हूँ | मैं कल सुबह के हवाई जहाज़ से भारत आ रही हूँ | तुम कैसी हो और क्या कर रही हो
turns.transliteration: namaste beTI, maiM ThIka hU.N aura abhI apanA sAmAna paika kara rahI hU.N | maiM kala subaha ke havAI jahAz se bhArata A rahI hU.N | tuma kaisI ho aura kyA kara rahI ho
turns.meaning: Hello daughter, I am fine and I am packing right now. I am coming to India by morning flight tomorrow. How are you and what are you doing

turns.hindi: मैं भी अच्छी हूँ, माँ | मैं हमारी यात्रा की योजना बना रही हूँ
turns.transliteration: maiM bhI achChI hU.N, mA.N | maiM hamArI yAtrA kI yojanA banA rahI hU.N
turns.meaning: I am well too, mother. I am making our travel plan

turns.hindi: मैं भी भारत-यात्रा के लिए बहुत उत्साहित हूँ | मुझे यात्रा की योजना के बारे में बताओ
turns.transliteration: maiM bhI bhArata-yAtrA ke lie bahuta utsAhita hU.N | mujhe yAtrA kI yojanA ke bAre meM batAo
turns.meaning: I am also very excited about India tour. Tell me about the travel plan

turns.hindi: ठीक है | मैं तुम से दिल्ली अन्तराष्ट्रीय हवाईअड्डे पर मिलूँगी | हम दिल्ली में दो दिन रुकेंगी और दिल्ली में लाल क़िला और कुतुबमीनार देखेंगी
turns.transliteration: ThIka hai | maiM tuma se dillI antarAShTrIya havAIaDDe para milU.NgI | hama dillI meM do dina rukeMgI aura dillI meM lAla qilA aura kutubamInAra dekheMgI
turns.meaning: Okay. I will meet you at the international airport in Delhi. We will stay in Delhi for two days and will visit Red fort and Qutub minar

turns.hindi: क्या हम जामा मस्जिद भी देखेंगी
turns.transliteration: kyA hama jAmA masjida bhI dekheMgI
turns.meaning: Will we visit Jama masjid too

turns.hindi: जी हाँ, जामा मस्जिद, लाल क़िला के पास ही है
turns.transliteration: jI hA.N, jAmA masjida, lAla qilA ke pAsa hI hai
turns.meaning: Yes, Jama masjid is near by the red fort

turns.hindi: बहुत अच्छा | उसके बाद हम कहाँ जायेंगी
turns.transliteration: bahuta achChA | usake bAda hama kahA.N jAyeMgI
turns.meaning: Very well. Where will we go after that

turns.hindi: दिल्ली के बाद हम जयपुर और उदयपुर जायेंगी | जयपुर और उदयपुर में, हम बहुत सारे क़िले देखेंगी, राजस्थानी खाना खायेंगी और ख़रीदारी भी करेंगी
turns.transliteration: dillI ke bAda hama jayapura aura udayapura jAyeMgI | jayapura aura udayapura meM, hama bahuta sAre qile dekheMgI, rAjasthAnI khAnA khAyeMgI aura khrIdArI bhI kareMgI
turns.meaning: After Delhi, we will go to Jaipur and Udaypur. In Jaipur and Udaypur, we will visit many forts, eat Rajasthani food, and do shopping too

turns.hindi: मैंने सुना है कि राजस्थानी हस्तशिल्प बहुत मशहूर है
turns.transliteration: maiMne sunA hai ki rAjasthAnI hastashilpa bahuta mashahUra hai
turns.meaning: I have heard that Rajasthani handicraft is very famous

turns.hindi: हाँ माँ, हम राजस्थान से पंजाब जायेंगी और बाघा बॉडर पर हिन्दुस्तानी और पाकिस्तानी सैनिकों का परेड देखेंगी
turns.transliteration: hA.N mA.N, hama rAjasthAna se paMjAba jAyeMgI aura bAghA baॉDara para hindustAnI aura pAkistAnI sainikoM kA pareDa dekheMgI
turns.meaning: Yes mother, we will go to Punjab from Rajasthan and will see a parade by Indian and Pakistani soldiers

turns.hindi: अरे वाह ! मैंने सुना है कि वह परेड बहुत नाटकीय है
turns.transliteration: are vAha ! maiMne sunA hai ki vaha pareDa bahuta nATakIya hai
turns.meaning: Wao! I have heard that the parade is very dramatic

turns.hindi: हाँ, हमें बहुत मज़ा आयेंगा | उसके बाद हम अमृतसर में गोल्डन टेम्पल देखेंगी और दिल्ली वापस आयेंगी
turns.transliteration: hA.N, hameM bahuta mazA AyeMgA | usake bAda hama amRRitasara meM golDana Tempala dekheMgI aura dillI vApasa AyeMgI
turns.meaning: Yes, we will have so much fun. After that we will go to visit golden temple in Amritsar and will return to Delhi

turns.hindi: यह तो बहुत अच्छी योजना है | तुम्हें अमेरिका से कुछ चाहिए
turns.transliteration: yaha to bahuta achChI yojanA hai | tumheM amerikA se kuCha chAhie
turns.meaning: This is such a good plan. Do you need anything from America

turns.hindi: नहीं माँ, मुझे कुछ नहीं चाहिए | मगर हाँ, तुम गर्म कपड़े मत लाना | आजकल हिन्दुस्तान में गर्मी का मौसम है
turns.transliteration: nahIM mA.N, mujhe kuCha nahIM chAhie | magara hA.N, tuma garma kapare mata lAnA | Ajakala hindustAna meM garmI kA mausama hai
turns.meaning: No mother, I do not need anything. But, please do not bring warm clothes. It is summer season in India these days

turns.hindi: ठीक है बेटी, मैं तुमसे दिल्ली हवाईअड्डे पर मिलूँगी
turns.transliteration: ThIka hai beTI, maiM tumase dillI havAIaDDe para milU.NgI
turns.meaning: Okay daughter, I will see you at Delhi airport

turns.hindi: नमस्ते शिल्पा, तुम कैसी हो
turns.transliteration: namaste shilpA, tuma kaisI ho
turns.meaning: Hello Shilpa, How are you

turns.hindi: मैं अच्छी हूँ | तुम कैसे हो
turns.transliteration: maiM achChI hU.N | tuma kaise ho
turns.meaning: I am well. How are you

turns.hindi: मैं भी अच्छा हूँ| तुम्हारी गर्मी की छुट्टियाँ कैसी थीं
turns.transliteration: maiM bhI achChA hU.N| tumhArI garmI kI ChuTTiyA.N kaisI thIM
turns.meaning: I, too, am well. How was your summer vacation

turns.hindi: मेरी गर्मी की छुट्टियाँ बहुत अच्छी थीं | मैं अपने परिवार के साथ हैदराबाद गयी थी
turns.transliteration: merI garmI kI ChuTTiyA.N bahuta achChI thIM | maiM apane parivAra ke sAtha haidarAbAda gayI thI
turns.meaning: My summer vacation was very good. I went to Hyderabad with my family

turns.hindi: अरे वाह ! हैदराबाद में तुम लोगों ने क्या – क्या किया
turns.transliteration: are vAha ! haidarAbAda meM tuma logoM ne kyA – kyA kiyA
turns.meaning: Oh wao! What did you do in Hyderabad

turns.hindi: हम लोग वहाँ एक सप्ताह रहे | हम ने शहर देखा | हम चार मीनार, गोलकुंडा फोर्ट, और रामू जी फ़िल्म सिटी गए | हम ने कई तरह की बिरयानियाँ खायीं | तुम गर्मी की छुटियों में कहाँ गए और क्या – क्या किया
turns.transliteration: hama loga vahA.N eka saptAha rahe | hama ne shahara dekhA | hama chAra mInAra, golakuMDA phorTa, aura rAmU jI filma siTI gae | hama ne kaI taraha kI birayAniyA.N khAyIM | tuma garmI kI ChuTiyoM meM kahA.N gae aura kyA – kyA kiyA
turns.meaning: We stayed there for a week. We saw the city. We wen to Char minar, Golkunda fort, and Ramu Ji film city. We ate different types of biryani. Where did you go in summer vacation and what did you do

turns.hindi: मैं अपने माता – पिता के घर, गोवा गया था | मैंने उनके साथ कुछ समय बिताया | मैंने घर की मरम्मत करने में उनकी मदद की
turns.transliteration: maiM apane mAtA – pitA ke ghara, govA gayA thA | maiMne unake sAtha kuCha samaya bitAyA | maiMne ghara kI marammata karane meM unakI madada kI
turns.meaning: I went to my parent’s house in Goa. I spent some times with them. I help them fixing their house

turns.hindi: अरे वाह ! और ऋतिक तुम ने गर्मी की छुट्टियों में क्या किया
turns.transliteration: are vAha ! aura RRitika tuma ne garmI kI ChuTTiyoM meM kyA kiyA
turns.meaning: Oh wao! and Hritik, what did you do during the summer vacation

turns.hindi: मैं घर पर ही था | मैंने  खाना पकाना सिखा
turns.transliteration: maiM ghara para hI thA | maiMne  khAnA pakAnA sikhA
turns.meaning: I was at home. I learnt how to cook

turns.hindi: अरे वाह ! यह तो बहुत अच्छी बात है | अब तो ऋतिक हमारे लिए खाना बना सकता है
turns.transliteration: are vAha ! yaha to bahuta achChI bAta hai | aba to RRitika hamAre lie khAnA banA sakatA hai
turns.meaning: Oh wao! This is great. Now Hritik can cook food for us

turns.transliteration: hA.N, kyoM nahIM
turns.meaning: Yes, why not

turns.hindi: नमस्ते ऋतिक, स्वतंत्रता दिवस की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएँ
turns.transliteration: namaste RRitika, svataMtratA divasa kI hArdika shubhakAmanAe.N
turns.meaning: Hello Hritik, happy independence day

turns.hindi: धन्यवाद पीटर भाई | तुम्हें भी स्वतंत्रता दिवस की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएँ ! तुम स्वतंत्रता दिवस कैसे मनाओगे
turns.transliteration: dhanyavAda pITara bhAI | tumheM bhI svataMtratA divasa kI hArdika shubhakAmanAe.N ! tuma svataMtratA divasa kaise manAoge
turns.meaning: Thanks brother Peter. Happy independence day to you too! How will you celebrate the independence day

turns.hindi: मैं अभी इंडिया गेट से स्वतंत्रता दिवस का परेड देख कर आया हूँ | इसके बाद मैं और मेरे कुछ दोस्त दिल्ली के ऐतिहासिक स्थान देखने जायेंगे | उसके बाद हम शायद बाहर खाना खायें |तुम क्या करोगे
turns.transliteration: maiM abhI iMDiyA geTa se svataMtratA divasa kA pareDa dekha kara AyA hU.N | isake bAda maiM aura mere kuCha dosta dillI ke aitihAsika sthAna dekhane jAyeMge | usake bAda hama shAyada bAhara khAnA khAyeM |tuma kyA karoge
turns.meaning: I am just coming from India gate after watching independence day’s parade. After this, Me and a few of my friends will go to visit some historical places. After that, perhaps, we might eat out. What will you do

turns.hindi: क्या बताऊँ? मेरी कोई योजना नहीं है | शायद, मैं घर जाके सोऊँ
turns.transliteration: kyA batAU.N? merI koI yojanA nahIM hai | shAyada, maiM ghara jAke soU.N
turns.meaning: What to tell? I have no plans. Perhaps, I might go home and sleep

turns.hindi: अगर तुम चाहो तो हमारे साथ चल सकते हो
turns.transliteration: agara tuma chAho to hamAre sAtha chala sakate ho
turns.meaning: If you want you can come with us

turns.hindi: नहीं दोस्त, मैं आज आराम करूँगा | मगर यह तो बताओ कि तुम लोग आज ऐतिहासिक स्थान देखने क्यों जा रहे हो
turns.transliteration: nahIM dosta, maiM Aja ArAma karU.NgA | magara yaha to batAo ki tuma loga Aja aitihAsika sthAna dekhane kyoM jA rahe ho
turns.meaning: No friend, I will rest today. But tell me why you all are going to visit historical places today

turns.hindi: क्योंकि हर राष्ट्रीय त्योहार में इन जगहों पर प्रवेश नि:शुल्क होता है
turns.transliteration: kyoMki hara rAShTrIya tyohAra meM ina jagahoM para pravesha ni:shulka hotA hai
turns.meaning: Because entry is free at all these places on national festival/holidays

turns.hindi: अरे वाह ! इंडिया में और कौन – कौन से राष्ट्रीय त्योहार हैं
turns.transliteration: are vAha ! iMDiyA meM aura kauna – kauna se rAShTrIya tyohAra haiM
turns.meaning: Oh Wao! What are the other national festivals in India

turns.hindi: हिन्दुस्तान में कई क्षेत्रीय त्योहार हैं, मगर राष्ट्रीय त्योहार सिर्फ़ तीन हैं –  स्वतंत्रता दिवस (15 अगस्त), गणतंत्रता दिवस जनवरी), और गाँधी जयन्ती (2 अक्टूबर
turns.transliteration: hindustAna meM kaI kShetrIya tyohAra haiM, magara rAShTrIya tyohAra sirf tIna haiM –  svataMtratA divasa (15 agasta), gaNataMtratA divasa janavarI), aura gA.NdhI jayantI (2 akTUbara
turns.meaning: 26 There are many regional festival/holiday, but there are only three national festivals/holidays – independence day (15 August), republic day (26 January), and Gandhi’s birthday (2nd October

turns.hindi: बहुत अच्छा ! शायद, मैं भी २ अक्टूबर को इन जगहों पर जाऊँ
turns.transliteration: bahuta achChA ! shAyada, maiM bhI 2 akTUbara ko ina jagahoM para jAU.N
turns.meaning: Very well ! Perhaps, I too will go to these places on 2nd October

turns.hindi: विद्या, आज तुम उदास क्यों लग रही हो ? क्या तुम्हें स्वतंत्रता दिवस की ख़ुशी नहीं है
turns.transliteration: vidyA, Aja tuma udAsa kyoM laga rahI ho ? kyA tumheM svataMtratA divasa kI khushI nahIM hai
turns.meaning: Vidya, why are you looking sad today? Are you not happy on independence day

turns.hindi: नहीं नहीं, ऐसी कोई बात नहीं है | मगर आज मेरा जन्मदिन भी है और सब मुझे स्वतंत्रता दिवस की शुभकामनाएँ दे रहे हैं, जन्मदिन की नहीं
turns.transliteration: nahIM nahIM, aisI koI bAta nahIM hai | magara Aja merA janmadina bhI hai aura saba mujhe svataMtratA divasa kI shubhakAmanAe.N de rahe haiM, janmadina kI nahIM
turns.meaning: No No, it is not like that. But today is my birthday too, and every one is wishing me happy independence day, and not happy birthday

turns.hindi: आज तुम्हारा जन्मदिन है? जन्मदिन की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएँ विद्या चलो आज हम सब तुम्हारा जन्मदिन मनायेंगे
turns.transliteration: Aja tumhArA janmadina hai? janmadina kI hArdika shubhakAmanAe.N vidyA chalo Aja hama saba tumhArA janmadina manAyeMge
turns.meaning: Today is your birthday? Happy birthday Vidya! Let’s celebrate your birthday together

turns.hindi: जन्मदिन मुबारक हो, विद्या
turns.transliteration: janmadina mubAraka ho, vidyA
turns.meaning: Happy birthday Vidya

turns.hindi: धन्यवाद ! तुम लोगों को भी स्वतंत्रता दिवस की शुभकामनाएँ
turns.transliteration: dhanyavAda ! tuma logoM ko bhI svataMtratA divasa kI shubhakAmanAe.N
turns.meaning: Thanks! Happy independence day to you all
